get.description:
This endpoint returns all chat conversations associated with the currently authenticated user.
A valid JWT token must be included in the Authorization header. The user's ID is extracted
from the token claims and used to fetch the relevant chat data.
            
If the user ID is missing or not a valid GUID, a 401 Unauthorized response is returned.
Appropriate error responses are returned in case of validation failures or internal errors.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of chats.

401.description: Unauthorized – missing or invalid JWT token.

get.description:
This endpoint returns a paginated list of messages from a conversation.  
If `fromMessageId` is provided, it returns messages after that ID;  
if `fromMessageId` is null, it returns an empty list (with 200 OK).  
A valid JWT token must be included in the Authorization header.  
If `conversationId` is missing, empty, or invalid, an error response is returned.

parameters.name: conversationId
parameters.description: The ID of the conversation (GUID). Required.

parameters.name: fromMessageId
parameters.description: The ID of the message after which to start fetching (GUID). Optional.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the paged messages (can be empty if fromMessageId is null).

401.description: Unauthorized – missing or invalid JWT token.

404.description: Conversation not found or access denied.

post.description:
This endpoint allows an authenticated user to send a friend invitation by providing the sender's and recipient's GUIDs.
Returns a ChatCommunicator.Contracts.Dtos.Friendships.SendInviteDto object containing the invitation ID on success, or an error response on failure.

requestBody.description: Invitation data including sender and recipient GUIDs.

400.description: Invalid invitation data (e.g., malformed or missing GUIDs).

get.description:
Returns all pending friend invitations for the specified user GUID.
If the user does not exist or input is invalid, returns appropriate error responses.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: GUID of the user whose invitations to retrieve.

get.summary: Get Users to Invite by Text
get.description:
Authenticated users can search for other users by username or display name.
The search excludes users who are already friends or already invited.
Requires a valid JWT token with user GUID.

400.description: Invalid request (e.g., empty or malformed input).

401.description: Unauthorized - JWT token missing or invalid.

post.description:
Allows an authenticated user to decline a friend invitation by providing sender and recipient GUIDs.
Returns appropriate errors if the invitation is invalid, already handled, or missing.

requestBody.description: Invitation data with sender and recipient GUIDs.

404.description: Invitation not found or already declined.

post.description:
Allows an authenticated user to accept a friend invitation by providing sender and recipient GUIDs.
On success, users are added to each other's friend lists and an ChatCommunicator.Contracts.Dtos.Friendships.AcceptFriendshipInviteDto object is returned.
The returned object includes the friendship ID and the conversation ID.
Returns errors for invalid input, not found invitations, or conflicts.

requestBody.description: Invitation data with sender and recipient GUIDs.

201.description: Invitation accepted; users are now friends. Returns ChatCommunicator.Contracts.Dtos.Friendships.AcceptFriendshipInviteDto.

409.description: Conflict - users already friends or invitation accepted.

get.description:
Fetches all users marked as friends of the specified user GUID.
Returns errors for invalid input or unexpected issues.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: GUID of the user whose friends to retrieve.

post.description:
This endpoint creates a new user using an email, username, and password. If the email already exists,
a conflict response is returned. On success, basic user data is returned.

requestBody.description: The registration data including email, username, and password.

400.description: Invalid registration data (e.g., password policy not met).

post.description:
This endpoint validates the provided login credentials. On success, it returns a JWT access token
and a refresh token. If authentication fails, a detailed error is returned.

requestBody.description: The login credentials, including username and password.

post.description: This endpoint checks the provided refresh token and issues a new access token if it's valid.

patch.description: Authenticated users can change their username. The new username must be unique.

401.description: User is not authenticated or token is invalid.

patch.description:
Authenticated users can change their password by providing the old password and a new password.
The new password must meet the required criteria.

requestBody.description: The DTO containing the old and new passwords.

400.description: Invalid input (e.g., missing user ID, invalid old or new password).

401.description: User is not authenticated or token is invalid.

post.description:
Authenticated users can upload a new avatar image. 
The uploaded file must meet specific requirements:

- Maximum file size: 5 MB.

- Maximum dimensions: 500x500 pixels.

- Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, etc.

200.description: Avatar successfully uploaded and URL returned.

400.description: Invalid file (e.g., empty, too big, wrong format, too large, too small).

401.description: User is not authenticated or token is invalid.

404.description: User not found in the system.

409.description: User already has an avatar set.

delete.description:
Authenticated users can delete their avatar. 
This action removes the avatar associated with the user account.

404.description: User not found in the system.

409.description: No avatar is set for this user, so there is nothing to delete.

put.description:
Authenticated users can change their avatar by uploading a new image. 
The uploaded file must meet specific requirements:

- Maximum file size: 5 MB.

- Maximum dimensions: 500x500 pixels.

- Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, etc.

200.description: Avatar successfully updated and URL returned.

400.description: Invalid file (e.g., empty, too big, wrong format, too large, too small).

401.description: User is not authenticated or token is invalid.

404.description: User not found in the system.

409.description: User does not have an avatar set to change.
